## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Source-side items (KB faithful to rule/compute):
- **SRC-1.** Ladders wr_early_pay_cost and yc_early_pay_cost: the lost-card tier reads "nbd_fee_bank_usd of the transfer's Access tier", while the rule ("the tier the worker's Access plan holds on the day the credit is figured, as the plan record shows it") and compute (CPARAM by access_plan_id) use the current tier.
  - Here the tier moved: Plus 1.49 on 2026-07-21, Premier 0.99 today.
  - So the ladder reading gives a final credit of 171.86, not 171.36.
- **SRC-2.** The tl baseline liability sentence ("the lesser of the disputed amount and the liability limit less the liability already charged on the same loss, never below zero") parses two ways.
  - Compute uses min(disputed, max(0, limit − charged)).
  - The other parse gives liability 0 and 208.95 instead of 191.95.
  - The Advantage computation doc carries the source wording verbatim.

Residue (not graded): no period close lines on the Access plan (112 rows, all access_earnings_sync). The fee rows (2.99 Plus on 07-21; 09-28 free as Preferred's one free instant; 2.79 Preferred on 10-01) and Premier effective 2026-10-10 are reachable one tier per review.
